repair.title: Invented repair assistance policy v1
repair.text: SYNTHETIC DEMO ONLY. In the fictional Cedar District, a repair-assistance request requires a completed form and a fictional inspection reference. A human reviewer assesses each request. This does not establish real-world eligibility.

application.title: Invented application process v1
application.text: SYNTHETIC DEMO ONLY. A fictional Cedar District application follows three steps: prepare the demonstration form, attach a fictional inspection reference, and request human review. No real identity documents should be submitted.
